name.fr-FR: Lettres inédites de saint Vincent de Paul (Mission et Charité, 1970)
name.en-US: Unpublished Letters of St. Vincent de Paul (Mission et Charité, 1970)
name.pt-BR: Cartas inéditas de São Vicente de Paulo (Mission et Charité, 1970)

description.fr-FR: Les lettres inédites de saint Vincent publiées dans Mission et Charité nos 19-20 (janvier-juin 1970), présentées comme « tome XV » de l’édition de Pierre Coste : lettres de Vincent et à Vincent, avec les notes de l’éditeur.
description.en-US: Letters 1 to 144 of St. Vincent’s Correspondence, vol. XV of Pierre Coste’s edition (1630-1660), one letter per chapter and grouped by year, with the letters addressed to Vincent that Coste interleaves, his source notices and notes.
description.pt-BR: As cartas 1 a 144 da Correspondência de São Vicente, tomo XV da edição de Pierre Coste (1630-1660).

fr-FR.editor: Mission et Charité (Congrégation de la Mission)

sources.edition: Lettres inédites de saint Vincent, Mission et Charité nos 19-20, janvier-juin 1970 (presented as tome XV of Coste’s edition); digital edition by P. Claude Lautissier C.M. and the Daughters of Charity on JesusMarie.com.
sources.description: All letters of the tome, one per chapter, including the letters to Vincent that Coste prints among them, with Coste’s source notices and footnotes kept as notes. Coste’s introduction is not included; letters whose heading the transcription lost stay inside the preceding chapter.
sources.tierEvidence: Freely distributed on JesusMarie.com; the underlying letters are by Vincent (d. 1660) and the editorial notes are those of the 1970 issue.
